parts.html: The K-19 kitchen model is designed for interiors where a practical cooking area needs to coexist with an open and uncluttered living space. Its 3.1-meter straight-line layout, coordinated beige cabinet fronts, and contemporary appearance create a versatile furniture composition for apartments, residential studios, and smaller private homes.

The beige color palette gives the kitchen a warm, understated character. It can be paired with light walls, natural wood textures, ceramic tile, and stone-effect surfaces, allowing the cabinetry to blend naturally into a variety of interior design schemes.
The solid-color finish keeps the composition visually consistent and emphasizes the simplicity of the furniture lines.

The defining feature of K-19 is its single-wall configuration. Positioning the kitchen along one wall helps preserve floor space for dining, circulation, or an adjoining living area. This arrangement can be particularly useful in open-plan apartments and residential interiors where efficient use of space matters.

The cabinetry has a linear length of 3.1 meters. During custom planning, the arrangement can be adapted to the intended positions of the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances. Cabinet organization and appliance placement are determined according to the room’s dimensions and service connections.

Both the upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. Using the same material and beige finish throughout creates a cohesive appearance without strong decorative contrasts. The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.

The chipboard-based countertop provides a practical surface for everyday food preparation. A straight-line arrangement also makes it possible to organize the main kitchen functions in a clear sequence, with storage distributed between upper and lower cabinets.
Muller soft-close hinges support smooth closing of hinged cabinet doors. Pull-out elements use concealed Muller drawer runners, while cabinet handles are included in the configuration.

The standard K-19 model does not include a kitchen island, pull-out cargo storage, or lift mechanisms. Its design focuses on a straightforward layout and the essential functions of a contemporary kitchen.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna. The K-19 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance requirements, and the location of plumbing and electrical connections.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, furniture manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and appliances can also be selected according to the client’s requirements.
